description: Source code for WebrtcVideoPerfRecorder class managing WebRTC video performance data recording, including creation, updating, starting new records, and finalizing records.

classes.name: WebrtcVideoPerfRecorder
classes.description: Class responsible for recording WebRTC video performance metrics, managing records for decode and encode streams, and persisting data via a callback.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a WebrtcVideoPerfRecorder with a given WebrtcVideoPerfHistory and receiver.

methods.name: WebrtcVideoPerfRecorder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the recorder with a save callback.

methods.name: ~WebrtcVideoPerfRecorder
methods.description: Destructor finalizing records upon object destruction.

methods.name: UpdateRecord
methods.description: Updates the current record with new features and video stats, starting a new record if features differ.

methods.name: StartNewRecord
methods.description: Begins a new record with provided features, finalizing the previous one.

methods.name: FinalizeRecord
methods.description: Finalizes and saves a record if it meets criteria, logging details.
